messages:
sam.t: Hey team — need a quick thumbs up. We're onboarding an external contractor to debug the S3 ingestion pipeline that's failing for a few customers. They only need console access to look at logs and job statuses for project 'ingest-prod' for ~2 hours. What's the minimal role we should give? Also any redaction/PII checklist before we let them view logs?

maya.k: @sam.t +1 on keeping this minimal. For console-level access to logs and job statuses we usually create a JIT elevation to a scoped role instead of Console Admin. Recommend: custom role `roles/ConsoleLimitedViewer` that includes: `logging.logEntries.list`, `monitoring.metricDescriptors.list`, `resourcemanager.projects.get` and read-only access to the specific project. No write perms.

maya.k: Also require:
- pre-sanitize logs where possible (mask emails, user_ids) using our log-redact pipeline (see runbook)
- contractor must sign NDA and have active Contractor AD group membership
- timeboxed 2h with automatic revoke
- request must include ticket link and approval from Eng oncall

alex.r: Agreed. From infra side we'll use the JIT access flow so we don't add the principal to a long-lived IAM binding. Steps:
1) Create access request in access-requests (link: https://console/internal/access-requests) with scope `projects/ingest-prod` and role `ConsoleLimitedViewer`.
2) @eng-oncall approves in thread.
3) infra-bot will provision temporary credentials for 2h and log the grant.

alex.r: Command if you need to do it manually (avoid unless infra flow fails):
```
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding ingest-prod \
  --member="user:contractor@example.com" \
  --role="projects/ingest-prod/roles/ConsoleLimitedViewer" \
  --condition="expression=request.time < timestamp_add(request.time, duration('2h'))"
```

jordan.p: Quick note on logs — the S3 ingestion errors include full S3 key paths which sometimes contain customer IDs. Please run a targeted scrub on keys with regex `cust_[0-9]{6}` before granting view. If scrub can't run, warp the logs to a redacted view and attach to the ticket.

maya.k: +1 to jordan. If redaction isn't practical, only grant access to an engineer who will remote into a redaction runner and view sanitized output. Also add an audit annotation on the request: `reason=contractor_debug_ingest_#4321` so we can trace.

infra-bot: Access workflow triggered by alex.r. Request ID: AR-2026-4827. Provisioning temporary role `ConsoleLimitedViewer` for user contractor@example.com for 2h. Audit link: https://console/internal/audit/AR-2026-4827

sam.t: Thanks. I've filed ticket #4321 with the scrub step and attached the sample logs. Adding the contractor to the access request now and pinging eng-oncall for approval.

maya.k: Once eng-oncall approves, I'll do a quick policy double-check. If anything looks off I'll revoke immediately. :shield:

jordan.p: pinging eng-oncall: @oncall — can you approve AR-2026-4827? We need this to unblock customers.

eng-oncall: Approved. Make sure the scrubbed artifact is linked on the ticket.

infra-bot: Access granted. User contractor@example.com now has `ConsoleLimitedViewer` on projects/ingest-prod until 2026-12-01T15:21:18Z. Audit recorded: AR-2026-4827.

sam.t: Confirmed access. Contractor confirmed they only saw the sanitized logs. Closing out once they finish run. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
